_limits: THE MANIFEST MAKES RECORDS DURABLE, NOT TRUE. A quote entered wrongly at creation time is preserved faithfully, hashed, and dated forever — initial verification is the single point of failure, and it has demonstrably failed once (col-prostate: a quote recorded as 'confirmed directly' that was never at the named source, evidenced by a Wayback snapshot predating the verification). The structural checks cannot reach that class; nothing can, except care at entry.
_ruling_statistics: Downgrade-to-illustrative works only for values with an honest illustrative home (colour). It does NOT work for statistics: a user reads '~92%' as fact regardless of labelling. For statistical claims the options are RE-SOURCE (durably-addressed) or REMOVE from the screen — no middle.
_backfill_method: Identifier backfill (2026-09-04): PubMed eutils esearch/esummary with a MULTI-FIELD AGREEMENT GATE — first-author surname + publication year + (journal when recorded) + topic-consistency, and EXACTLY ONE candidate may pass; ambiguous or partial matches are refused, never guessed. Backfilled identifiers carry method+date and DO NOT have the evidentiary weight of identifiers recorded at entry time: they assert 'this recorded metadata resolves uniquely to this paper', not 'this paper was verified to support the claim'. Triage semantics: status=no-match (author+year yields zero PubMed hits) is the strong entry-time-error signature (the Wang/Park case); status=no-field-match is NOT a defect list — it mixes common-surname retrieval misses, retmax truncation, and title-topic gate strictness, and means 'not auto-resolvable', nothing more. SWEEP 2 (2026-09-04, same gate, leakier-retrieval fixes user-specified after the Louis case): PubMed retmax raised 8->100 with the esearch total count recorded (count>100 = saturated, exhaustiveness cannot be claimed); topic terms placed IN the query (All Fields: title+abstract+MeSH) as well as the post-hoc title check, with the instrument recorded per entry (topic:title vs topic:query); Crossref added as a second engine (different index, fuzzy bibliographic matching); passers identity-deduped across engines by title-token Jaccard>=0.7 and the union must contain EXACTLY ONE paper. Residue subclasses replace no-field-match: ambiguous-2 (multiple genuine passers — several are two real same-author-same-year papers), saturated (query too big to sweep), zero-pass (candidates exist, none pass all fields).

Zero journal-mismatches is structural, not suspicious: when a journal was recorded it was enforced INSIDE the query ([ta] field), so a journal mismatch presents as zero hits, not as a post-hoc mismatch. The A+Y-only class was tested against ground truth and FAILED 2/3: one backfill attached a plant-genetics paper to a thyroid line whose true PMID sat on the next source line; one attached an unrelated methods paper to a NEGATED mention inside an authorship-correction comment. On every backfill testable against an entry-time identifier, the >=3-field machinery went 4/4 correct (Jakob, Livasy, Luvhengo via sweep-1; Wippold via sweep-2) and A+Y-only went 2/2 wrong. RULE ADOPTED: automated backfill requires at least three agreeing fields; author+year+uniqueness alone is never sufficient. Every backfilled entry now carries fieldsChecked — the strength actually applied, not the strength specified. RULE SUPERSEDED (2026-09-04): the wrong-backfill census is CATEGORICAL, not a threshold result — all four wrong backfills in the no-journal class, zero in any journal-checked class. Minimum-three counted fields as fungible when the data says they are not: journal names are high-entropy and nearly impossible to match spuriously; topic is low-entropy, substring-prone, and was actively defective. JOURNAL IS NOW REQUIRED for automated backfill (author+year+journal at minimum; evidence: ~14% error rate in the no-journal class, 4/29). v2's 73% journal recall makes this affordable where v1's 44% would not have. Records without a journal anywhere on the line can only be resolved by a HUMAN title-read (fieldsChecked carries title:human), never automatically.

_m1_rules: M1-WIDE RULES (2026-09-04, user rulings). SCOPE-FIRST IS THE M1-WIDE DEFAULT, not just the annotation sub-batch: every defect found in M1 and testis.js so far is a scope drift (Paly, kidneys' dropped sporadic, testis's German registry — three for three) against ~17 figures checked with zero errors. Mechanically sensible: a number is copied atomically — it matches or it doesn't — while a population descriptor gets paraphrased into UI copy, and paraphrase is where qualifiers fall out; compression lands on prose, not digits. Scope check = one methods read (cheap); figure-hunting in full text is the expensive part. ADAPTIVE GATE: figure spot-check rate is tied to the running figure-error count and rises the moment one appears — 17-for-zero is suggestive, not settled. SECONDARY-SOURCE RULE: when a primary is unreachable, finding its figure quoted in a review or later paper does NOT verify the claim — it verifies that someone else read it that way, a different assertion (the same chain this project refused under the license-laundering and same-artist rules). If a secondary is all that's available, the record is state 5 WITH the secondary noted as corroboration, never a verified-quoted with a substituted source. Brenner/Guichard/Livasy stay provisional until publisher routes are actually tried. THE DIRECTION (2026-09-04, user ruling — recorded alongside the scope-first default because it sharpens it into an instrument): ALL SEVEN defects found so far drift the SAME WAY — 15-20% instead of >20% (CCNE1); TNBC instead of basal-like (a CATEGORY SUBSTITUTION, not a rounding: one is immunohistochemical ER-/PR-/HER2-, the other a gene-expression intrinsic subtype, defined by different instruments); BRCA1 alone instead of BRCA1/2 (one gene as a family); "overall" instead of HER2-enriched (a subtype rate as a population rate); Paly (infradiaphragmatic adenopathy narrowed-sounding but actually generalised to "isolated nodal relapse"); kidneys (sporadic dropped); testis (a German registry as the world). Seven for seven: every defect states the finding MORE BROADLY than the source supports. Uncited figures and scope drifts share one mechanism — paraphrase toward the general; compression drops qualifiers rather than adding them.
